# Thistle Run

Thistle Run is the network's own van fleet for moving library materials between the five branches. It replaced two outside arrangements in January 2026: the Ridgeway Freight contract that served Main Street, Pinecrest, and Millbrook, and the county van that served Harlow Junction and Eastgate on alternate days.

## Why

Two haulers meant two schedules, two sets of bins, and holds that waited an extra day whenever an item crossed from one set of stops to the other. Ridgeway also raised its rate by 18 percent for 2026.

## What it includes

Two network vans, two part-time drivers, and a sorting room in the Millbrook branch basement. Every branch gets a stop each weekday.

## Contacts

[[Jory Petrakis]] runs the vans and the sorting room. Stop times are in the [[Van route timetable]].
